name: Slang.ai
positioning: A voice AI concierge built specifically for restaurants and hospitality groups, handling reservations, questions and private-event leads by phone.

pricing.model: Per-location plans (Core, Premium) plus custom Enterprise; quote-based
pricing.headline: Core from $399 per location and Premium from $599 per location (billing period not stated on the page); Enterprise custom.
planNotes: Core: 'Starting at $399 per location' (also shown in CAD and AUD at the same numbers).
Premium: 'Starting at $599 per location'; adds Superhost conversations, 97 languages, custom branding, QA, cross-selling, real-time alerts.
Enterprise: custom pricing with custom workflows/integrations, reporting, SSO/MFA controls.
Each plan button reads 'Get a quote', so final price is quote-based.
The page does not state whether the per-location price is monthly or annual, or whether usage/minute limits apply.
whatIsExtra: Private Events capture is listed as an a-la-carte product (price not shown).

strengths.claim: Purpose-built for restaurants with listed reservation integrations: OpenTable, SevenRooms, Yelp and Resy.
Private-event lead capture via Tripleseat and Perfect Venue integrations.
States setup takes under 30 minutes of the customer's time with same-day go-live possible.
Premium plan lists 97 languages with automatic switching mid-call, 20 premium voices and custom greetings.
Vendor states VIP call routing, CSAT capture on every call and call recordings with summaries.

limitations.claim: Per-location, quote-based pricing; the page shows 'Starting at' figures rather than usage rates.
The FAQ says Slang provides a new phone number, and keeping an existing number should be discussed with onboarding.

compliance.note: Stated by vendor, self-attested: the pricing page comparison table says 'SOC II compliant'. No HIPAA or GDPR statement found on the pages read; a Trust Center link exists but was not read.

telephony.providedNumbers: Slang provides a new local or toll-free number; keeping an existing number is described as possible after discussion with onboarding.

bestFor: Restaurants and hospitality groups that want a managed, restaurant-specific phone concierge tied to reservation systems.
unknowns: Billing period (monthly/annual) of the per-location price
Included call volume or overage rates
HIPAA and GDPR statements (Trust Center not read)
Agent export or data portability terms
